title: NUHCS and NUH lead cardiac care with safer, less invasive imaging for high-risk patients
version: Joint hospital media release posted 18 May 2026.
lineage: Operator records a completed patient evaluation and subsequent treatment. A photograph identifies Siemens as manufacturer but the article does not identify a model variant.

passages.note: Documents deployment by NUHCS and NUH and describes one completed patient assessment using photon-counting CT by the announcement date.
